def policy_code(observation, policy_state):
    device = observation.device
    num_envs = observation.shape[0]

    def clamp(x, lo, hi):
        return torch.clamp(x, lo, hi)

    def wrap_to_pi(x):
        return torch.atan2(torch.sin(x), torch.cos(x))

    def world_to_local_vec(dx, dy, yaw):
        cy = torch.cos(yaw)
        sy = torch.sin(yaw)
        lx = cy * dx + sy * dy
        ly = -sy * dx + cy * dy
        return lx, ly

    def local_to_world_vec(lx, ly, yaw):
        cy = torch.cos(yaw)
        sy = torch.sin(yaw)
        wx = cy * lx - sy * ly
        wy = sy * lx + cy * ly
        return wx, wy

    if policy_state is None:
        policy_state = {
            "needs_init": torch.ones(num_envs, dtype=torch.bool, device=device),
            "phase": torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
            "hold_count": torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
            "place_count": torch.zeros(num_envs, dtype=torch.long, device=device),
            "nav_side": torch.ones(num_envs, device=device),
            "filtered_box_x": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
            "filtered_box_y": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
            "filtered_target_x": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
            "filtered_target_y": torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device),
        }

    reset_mask = policy_state["needs_init"]
    if torch.any(reset_mask):
        policy_state["phase"][reset_mask] = 0
        policy_state["hold_count"][reset_mask] = 0
        policy_state["place_count"][reset_mask] = 0
        policy_state["nav_side"][reset_mask] = 1.0
        policy_state["filtered_box_x"][reset_mask] = observation[reset_mask, 13]
        policy_state["filtered_box_y"][reset_mask] = observation[reset_mask, 14]
        policy_state["filtered_target_x"][reset_mask] = observation[reset_mask, 25]
        policy_state["filtered_target_y"][reset_mask] = observation[reset_mask, 26]
    policy_state["needs_init"][reset_mask] = False

    # Parse observation
    root_x = observation[:, 0]
    root_y = observation[:, 1]
    root_yaw = observation[:, 2]

    left_ee_x = observation[:, 6]
    left_ee_y = observation[:, 7]
    left_ee_z = observation[:, 8]
    right_ee_x = observation[:, 9]
    right_ee_y = observation[:, 10]
    right_ee_z = observation[:, 11]

    torso_height_obs = observation[:, 12]

    box_x = observation[:, 13]
    box_y = observation[:, 14]
    box_z = observation[:, 15]
    box_yaw = observation[:, 16]

    target_x = observation[:, 25]
    target_y = observation[:, 26]

    last_action = observation[:, 27:37]

    # Low-pass filter key world positions a bit for smoother switching
    alpha = 0.2
    policy_state["filtered_box_x"] = (1 - alpha) * policy_state["filtered_box_x"] + alpha * box_x
    policy_state["filtered_box_y"] = (1 - alpha) * policy_state["filtered_box_y"] + alpha * box_y
    policy_state["filtered_target_x"] = (1 - alpha) * policy_state["filtered_target_x"] + alpha * target_x
    policy_state["filtered_target_y"] = (1 - alpha) * policy_state["filtered_target_y"] + alpha * target_y

    fbox_x = policy_state["filtered_box_x"]
    fbox_y = policy_state["filtered_box_y"]
    ftarget_x = policy_state["filtered_target_x"]
    ftarget_y = policy_state["filtered_target_y"]

    # Box wide side direction is box_yaw-aligned, grip from +/- normal to that axis
    box_axis_x = torch.cos(box_yaw)
    box_axis_y = torch.sin(box_yaw)
    box_norm_x = -torch.sin(box_yaw)
    box_norm_y = torch.cos(box_yaw)

    # Distances / geometry
    root_to_box_dx = fbox_x - root_x
    root_to_box_dy = fbox_y - root_y
    root_box_dist = torch.sqrt(root_to_box_dx * root_to_box_dx + root_to_box_dy * root_to_box_dy + 1e-8)

    box_to_target_dx = ftarget_x - fbox_x
    box_to_target_dy = ftarget_y - fbox_y
    box_target_dist = torch.sqrt(box_to_target_dx * box_to_target_dx + box_to_target_dy * box_to_target_dy + 1e-8)

    # Choose which side of the box to approach from, based on target direction:
    # stand on opposite side of where we want to carry toward.
    side_score = box_to_target_dx * box_norm_x + box_to_target_dy * box_norm_y
    desired_side = torch.where(side_score >= 0.0, -torch.ones_like(side_score), torch.ones_like(side_score))
    desired_side = torch.where(root_box_dist > 0.75, desired_side, policy_state["nav_side"])

    phase = policy_state["phase"]

    # Phase transitions
    # 0: navigate to side-approach staging point
    # 1: align and open hands wide near box
    # 2: clamp / grasp
    # 3: carry to target
    # 4: place and release
    # 5: retreat
    approach_offset = 0.66
    staging_x = fbox_x + desired_side * box_norm_x * approach_offset
    staging_y = fbox_y + desired_side * box_norm_y * approach_offset
    staging_dx = staging_x - root_x
    staging_dy = staging_y - root_y
    staging_dist = torch.sqrt(staging_dx * staging_dx + staging_dy * staging_dy + 1e-8)

    desired_yaw_to_box = torch.atan2(fbox_y - root_y, fbox_x - root_x)
    yaw_err_to_box = wrap_to_pi(desired_yaw_to_box - root_yaw)

    near_staging = staging_dist < 0.10
    facing_box = torch.abs(yaw_err_to_box) < 0.25

    phase0_to_1 = (phase == 0) & near_staging & facing_box
    phase = torch.where(phase0_to_1, torch.ones_like(phase), phase)

    # In phase 1, require the box to be reachable in local frame and facing correct
    box_lx, box_ly = world_to_local_vec(fbox_x - root_x, fbox_y - root_y, root_yaw)
    good_reach = (box_lx > 0.18) & (box_lx < 0.34) & (torch.abs(box_ly) < 0.12) & (root_box_dist < 0.42)
    phase1_to_2 = (phase == 1) & good_reach & facing_box
    phase = torch.where(phase1_to_2, torch.full_like(phase, 2), phase)

    # Detect stable grasp-like posture by commanded hands near symmetric clamp points
    # Use observed hand positions for robustness
    hand_mid_x = 0.5 * (left_ee_x + right_ee_x)
    hand_mid_y = 0.5 * (left_ee_y + right_ee_y)
    hand_mid_z = 0.5 * (left_ee_z + right_ee_z)
    grasp_ready = (
        (hand_mid_x > 0.18) & (hand_mid_x < 0.36) &
        (torch.abs(hand_mid_y) < 0.10) &
        (hand_mid_z > 0.06) & (hand_mid_z < 0.34) &
        (left_ee_y > 0.10) & (right_ee_y < -0.10)
    )

    box_still_supported = box_z > 0.45
    box_still_near = root_box_dist < 0.44
    policy_state["hold_count"] = torch.where(
        phase == 2,
        policy_state["hold_count"] + 1,
        torch.zeros_like(policy_state["hold_count"])
    )
    phase2_to_3 = (phase == 2) & (policy_state["hold_count"] > 8) & box_still_supported & box_still_near
    phase = torch.where(phase2_to_3, torch.full_like(phase, 3), phase)

    # At target, transition to place
    phase3_to_4 = (phase == 3) & (box_target_dist < 0.14)
    phase = torch.where(phase3_to_4, torch.full_like(phase, 4), phase)

    # Wait a bit in place/release then retreat
    policy_state["place_count"] = torch.where(
        phase == 4,
        policy_state["place_count"] + 1,
        torch.zeros_like(policy_state["place_count"])
    )
    phase4_to_5 = (phase == 4) & (policy_state["place_count"] > 10)
    phase = torch.where(phase4_to_5, torch.full_like(phase, 5), phase)

    # If box is still far from target after retreat started, keep retreat briefly then done-like idle.
    # If task seems not yet complete and box drifted, reattempt carry.
    phase5_to_3 = (phase == 5) & (box_target_dist > 0.22)
    phase = torch.where(phase5_to_3, torch.full_like(phase, 3), phase)

    policy_state["phase"] = phase
    policy_state["nav_side"] = desired_side

    # Default action: use last action as base for smoothness
    action = last_action.clone()

    # Defaults
    cmd_vx = torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device)
    cmd_vy = torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device)
    cmd_wz = torch.zeros(num_envs, device=device)

    ltx = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.22, device=device)
    lty = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.24, device=device)
    ltz = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.12, device=device)

    rtx = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.22, device=device)
    rty = torch.full((num_envs,), -0.24, device=device)
    rtz = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.12, device=device)

    torso_cmd = torch.full((num_envs,), 0.82, device=device)

    # Helper for root velocity control toward world point
    def drive_to_point(goal_x, goal_y, desired_yaw=None, vx_gain=1.5, vy_gain=1.2, yaw_gain=1.5, max_vx=0.8, max_vy=0.35):
        dx = goal_x - root_x
        dy = goal_y - root_y
        lx, ly = world_to_local_vec(dx, dy, root_yaw)
        vx = clamp(vx_gain * lx, -0.25, max_vx)
        vy = clamp(vy_gain * ly, -max_vy, max_vy)
        if desired_yaw is None:
            yaw_goal = torch.atan2(dy, dx)
        else:
            yaw_goal = desired_yaw
        yaw_err = wrap_to_pi(yaw_goal - root_yaw)
        wz = clamp(yaw_gain * yaw_err, -1.0, 1.0)
        slow = clamp(torch.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / 0.5, 0.15, 1.0)
        vx = vx * slow
        vy = vy * slow
        return vx, vy, wz

    # Phase 0: navigate to staging point offset from box, respecting podium clearance by using side offset.
    mask = phase == 0
    if torch.any(mask):
        vx, vy, wz = drive_to_point(staging_x, staging_y, desired_yaw=desired_yaw_to_box, max_vx=0.75, max_vy=0.30)
        cmd_vx[mask] = vx[mask]
        cmd_vy[mask] = vy[mask]
        cmd_wz[mask] = wz[mask]

        ltx[mask] = 0.18
        lty[mask] = 0.26
        ltz[mask] = 0.08
        rtx[mask] = 0.18
        rty[mask] = -0.26
        rtz[mask] = 0.08
        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.84

    # Phase 1: inch forward, align square to the box, open hands wide from sides
    mask = phase == 1
    if torch.any(mask):
        box_lx_now, box_ly_now = world_to_local_vec(fbox_x - root_x, fbox_y - root_y, root_yaw)
        desired_lx = 0.25
        desired_ly = 0.0
        cmd_vx[mask] = clamp(1.4 * (box_lx_now[mask] - desired_lx), -0.10, 0.14)
        cmd_vy[mask] = clamp(1.8 * (box_ly_now[mask] - desired_ly), -0.14, 0.14)
        cmd_wz[mask] = clamp(1.4 * yaw_err_to_box[mask], -0.5, 0.5)

        grip_z = clamp((box_z - torso_height_obs) + 0.03, 0.04, 0.26)
        center_x = clamp(box_lx_now - 0.01, 0.19, 0.29)

        # Open wide from the sides of the box
        half_width_open = 0.21
        ltx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        lty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] + half_width_open, 0.14, 0.34)
        ltz[mask] = grip_z[mask]

        rtx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        rty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] - half_width_open, -0.34, -0.14)
        rtz[mask] = grip_z[mask]

        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.80

    # Phase 2: clamp hands inward while staying nearly still
    mask = phase == 2
    if torch.any(mask):
        box_lx_now, box_ly_now = world_to_local_vec(fbox_x - root_x, fbox_y - root_y, root_yaw)
        cmd_vx[mask] = clamp(1.0 * (box_lx_now[mask] - 0.25), -0.04, 0.06)
        cmd_vy[mask] = clamp(1.4 * box_ly_now[mask], -0.04, 0.04)
        cmd_wz[mask] = clamp(1.0 * yaw_err_to_box[mask], -0.35, 0.35)

        grip_z = clamp((box_z - torso_height_obs) + 0.04, 0.05, 0.28)
        center_x = clamp(box_lx_now - 0.005, 0.20, 0.30)

        # Box side face from center: half of narrow dimension 0.16 => 0.08,
        # plus hand radius offset slightly outside before clamp.
        clamp_y = 0.115

        ltx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        lty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] + clamp_y, 0.10, 0.24)
        ltz[mask] = grip_z[mask]

        rtx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        rty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] - clamp_y, -0.24, -0.10)
        rtz[mask] = grip_z[mask]

        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.79

    # Phase 3: carry box to target while maintaining clamp
    mask = phase == 3
    if torch.any(mask):
        # Aim root slightly behind box-target line so carried box leads the torso less
        carry_goal_x = ftarget_x
        carry_goal_y = ftarget_y
        desired_yaw_carry = torch.atan2(ftarget_y - root_y, ftarget_x - root_x)

        vx, vy, wz = drive_to_point(carry_goal_x, carry_goal_y, desired_yaw=desired_yaw_carry, max_vx=0.55, max_vy=0.22)
        cmd_vx[mask] = vx[mask]
        cmd_vy[mask] = vy[mask]
        cmd_wz[mask] = 0.8 * wz[mask]

        box_lx_now, box_ly_now = world_to_local_vec(fbox_x - root_x, fbox_y - root_y, root_yaw)
        carry_z = clamp((box_z - torso_height_obs) + 0.07, 0.10, 0.32)
        center_x = clamp(box_lx_now, 0.21, 0.31)
        carry_clamp_y = 0.115

        ltx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        lty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] + carry_clamp_y, 0.10, 0.24)
        ltz[mask] = carry_z[mask]

        rtx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        rty[mask] = clamp(box_ly_now[mask] - carry_clamp_y, -0.24, -0.10)
        rtz[mask] = carry_z[mask]

        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.83

    # Phase 4: set down and release
    mask = phase == 4
    if torch.any(mask):
        cmd_vx[mask] = 0.0
        cmd_vy[mask] = 0.0
        cmd_wz[mask] = 0.0

        box_lx_now, box_ly_now = world_to_local_vec(fbox_x - root_x, fbox_y - root_y, root_yaw)

        place_z = clamp((box_z - torso_height_obs) + 0.03, 0.08, 0.22)
        center_x = clamp(box_lx_now + 0.01, 0.20, 0.32)

        # First a few steps keep clamped, then open
        open_mask = policy_state["place_count"] > 4

        ltx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        ltz[mask] = place_z[mask]
        rtx[mask] = center_x[mask]
        rtz[mask] = place_z[mask]

        lty_hold = clamp(box_ly_now + 0.11, 0.10, 0.24)
        rty_hold = clamp(box_ly_now - 0.11, -0.24, -0.10)
        lty_open = clamp(box_ly_now + 0.22, 0.16, 0.34)
        rty_open = clamp(box_ly_now - 0.22, -0.34, -0.16)

        lty = torch.where(mask & open_mask, lty_open, lty)
        rty = torch.where(mask & open_mask, rty_open, rty)
        lty = torch.where(mask & (~open_mask), lty_hold, lty)
        rty = torch.where(mask & (~open_mask), rty_hold, rty)

        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.80

    # Phase 5: retreat hands and back away
    mask = phase == 5
    if torch.any(mask):
        retreat_goal_x = root_x - 0.20 * torch.cos(root_yaw)
        retreat_goal_y = root_y - 0.20 * torch.sin(root_yaw)
        dx = retreat_goal_x - root_x
        dy = retreat_goal_y - root_y
        lx, ly = world_to_local_vec(dx, dy, root_yaw)

        cmd_vx[mask] = clamp(2.0 * lx[mask], -0.35, 0.05)
        cmd_vy[mask] = clamp(2.0 * ly[mask], -0.15, 0.15)
        cmd_wz[mask] = 0.0

        ltx[mask] = 0.18
        lty[mask] = 0.28
        ltz[mask] = 0.10
        rtx[mask] = 0.18
        rty[mask] = -0.28
        rtz[mask] = 0.10
        torso_cmd[mask] = 0.84

    # Smooth actions with previous action to reduce chatter
    target_action = torch.stack(
        [
            clamp(cmd_vx, -0.6, 1.0),
            clamp(cmd_vy, -0.5, 0.5),
            clamp(cmd_wz, -1.0, 1.0),
            clamp(ltx, 0.15, 0.45),
            clamp(lty, 0.10, 0.38),
            clamp(ltz, -0.1, 0.5),
            clamp(rtx, 0.15, 0.45),
            clamp(rty, -0.38, -0.1),
            clamp(rtz, -0.1, 0.5),
            clamp(torso_cmd, 0.5, 0.95),
        ],
        dim=1,
    )

    smooth = 0.35
    action = smooth * last_action + (1.0 - smooth) * target_action

    # Force exact clamp after smoothing
    action[:, 0] = clamp(action[:, 0], -0.6, 1.0)
    action[:, 1] = clamp(action[:, 1], -0.5, 0.5)
    action[:, 2] = clamp(action[:, 2], -1.0, 1.0)
    action[:, 3] = clamp(action[:, 3], 0.15, 0.45)
    action[:, 4] = clamp(action[:, 4], 0.10, 0.38)
    action[:, 5] = clamp(action[:, 5], -0.1, 0.5)
    action[:, 6] = clamp(action[:, 6], 0.15, 0.45)
    action[:, 7] = clamp(action[:, 7], -0.38, -0.10)
    action[:, 8] = clamp(action[:, 8], -0.1, 0.5)
    action[:, 9] = clamp(action[:, 9], 0.5, 0.95)

    return action, policy_state
